rules.explanation_template: The bath room is evaluated against the east Vastu zone using the frozen directional rule evidence.

source_refs.interpretation_note: This candidate encodes only the positively stated East placement for RoomType.bath. Toilet placement is not inferred from this rule.
source_refs.locator: Bathroom section states that bathrooms should be constructed in the East and separately discusses exclusions and attached-toilet constraints.

rules.explanation_template: The kitchen is evaluated against the southeast Vastu zone using the frozen directional rule evidence.

source_refs.interpretation_note: Used as corroborating practical interpretation. Alternative placements discussed in the wider source are intentionally not encoded until expert review defines precedence/exception semantics.

rules.explanation_template: The master bedroom is evaluated against the south or southwest Vastu zone using the frozen directional rule evidence.

source_refs.interpretation_note: Candidate rule narrows the encoded primary master-bedroom set to S and SW, matching the practical summary in the same source. Other bedroom occupant-specific guidance is deferred.
source_refs.locator: Bedroom-direction discussion: South and West are described as suitable, South as best; later practical guidance gives South and Southwest in order of suitability and discusses master-bedroom placement in South/Southwest.

rules.explanation_template: The puja/meditation room is evaluated against the northeast Vastu zone using the frozen directional rule evidence.

source_refs.locator: Translated directional list in the article section beginning with the meaning of the cited Sanskrit verse; worship/meditation chamber is assigned to the ishana (northeast) corner.
